name: new-badges-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `newBadges` flag (simple tier — resolves the same in both modes). The only live wiring is the 'Style quiz' row in the Tools menu (ToolsMenu.tsx, newFlag="styleQuiz"), gated by useNewBadge (src/ui/newBadges.ts): show = newBadges && targetFlag && NEW_BADGES[target] is recent && not yet seen. Both real NEW_BADGES entries (styleQuiz, parallelProjection) have long aged out of the recency window (their APP_VERSION has since moved a minor line past them), so this scenario monkeypatches NEW_BADGES.styleQuiz to the LIVE APP_VERSION via a page-context dynamic import (the same 'private module-level signal, driven via dynamic import' technique from the batch-5 gotchas) to make the badge 'recently introduced' again for the duration of the run — the wiring itself (useNewBadge → .new-dot render) is untouched. Since the Tools menu itself only mounts in Pro mode (proMode && <ToolsMenu/> in Toolbar.tsx), the ladder is: (1) no Tools button at all in Simple, (2) in Pro, the dot IS present once styleQuiz + newBadges + a patched-recent entry all line up, (3) a direct setFeatureFlag(newBadges,false) override removes the dot while the row itself stays visible (targetFlag still on), (4) restoring newBadges brings the dot back — isolating newBadges' own effect from styleQuiz's.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-newbadges-flag-on-simple
steps.failMessage: newBadges should default ON (simple tier, default:true)

steps.name: assert-no-tools-button-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Tools'); if (btn) throw new Error('Tools menu button unexpectedly present in Simple mode (ToolsMenu is Pro-only)'); })()

steps.name: patch-new-badges-recency
steps.eval: (async function(){ const [nb, ver] = await Promise.all([import('/src/ui/newBadges.ts'), import('/src/version.ts')]); nb.NEW_BADGES.styleQuiz = ver.APP_VERSION; window.__patchedNewBadges = nb; })()

steps.name: verify-stylequiz-flag-on-pro
steps.failMessage: styleQuiz should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: assert-dot-present-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Style quiz')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Style quiz row not found in Tools menu'); const dot = btn.querySelector('.new-dot'); if (!dot) throw new Error('No .new-dot on Style quiz row with newBadges ON + a freshly-patched-recent NEW_BADGES entry'); })()

steps.name: assert-row-stays-dot-gone
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Style quiz')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Style quiz row disappeared entirely (should stay — only its badge is newBadges-gated, the row itself is styleQuiz-gated)'); const dot = btn.querySelector('.new-dot'); if (dot) throw new Error('.new-dot still present after setFeatureFlag(newBadges, false)'); })()

steps.name: assert-dot-restored
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Style quiz')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Style quiz row not found after restoring newBadges'); const dot = btn.querySelector('.new-dot'); if (!dot) throw new Error('.new-dot did not return after restoring newBadges to true'); })()
